# not quantized by llama.cpp; the pinned gguf-py writer lacks IQ quantizers.
# y for every case: gguf-py 0.19.0 dequantize_blocks of the wire bytes (f32LE hex).

# build-vulkan-muse libggml-base.so.0.19.0, dequantized every fixture row
